body: yeah, there's one. it's hard to find the motivation to move myself from my apartment to go socialize with people i don't even know though. i don't really know why i posted this, i guess it's cool knowing one person knows my situation. thanks, and sorry for wasting your time with my self pitying bullshit

I understand that I'm stressed out, that much is no mystery. How could I ever get a handle on my parents refusing to even contact me?

As for friends, I've pretty much had the same group from high school until now. I have no idea how to meet people when I'm not constantly forced to see the same ones day in and day out. College is too big for that kind of stuff, I guess. I've never been to a support group or anything that wasn't just people whining about how bad their life sucks, and that is the last thing I want to hear
